defs.def: the good feeling that you have when you have achieved sth or when sth that you wanted to happen does happen; sth that gives you this feeling 满足；满意；欣慰；令人满意（或欣慰）的事

ex.s: Helping strangers can leave you with a deep sense of satisfaction, but you’ve likely also felt the stress of showing up for others when you’re already stretched thin.
ex.t: 帮助陌生人会给你一种深深的满足感，但你也可能体会过在自己已经分身乏术时还要为他人付出的压力。

ex.s: “People who live in plant-rich environments report a higher life satisfaction rating, ” she says.
ex.t: “生活在植物丰富环境中的人，报告了更高的生活满意度，”她说。

ex.s: Therefore, they do not feel the satisfaction of being academically challenged.
ex.t: 因此，他们感受不到学业挑战带来的满足感。

ex.s: Such people show greater overall life satisfaction, too.
ex.t: 这样的人也表现出更高的整体生活满足感。

ex.s: We are tempted by sugary treats because our ancestors lived in a calorie-poor world, and our brains developed a response mechanism to these treats that reflected their value — a feeling of reward and satisfaction.
ex.t: 我们会被含糖零食诱惑，因为我们的祖先生活在热量匮乏的世界里，而我们的大脑形成了一种对这些零食的响应机制，反映出它们的价值——一种奖励和满足感。

ex.s: People’s hesitancy to delay satisfaction is the most obvious example, but there are others.
ex.t: 人们不愿意延迟满足是最明显的例子，但还有其他例子。

ex.s: So, when people do things to increase their life satisfaction, they also make themselves more effective at work.”
ex.t: 因此，当人们做一些能提高生活满意度的事情时，他们也使自己工作效率更高。"

ex.s: Content with what he had, his greatest satisfaction was in his work and in inspiring those around him to take pleasure in learning.
ex.t: 他最满意的是他的工作和激励周围的人在学习中享受乐趣。

ex.s: Moreover, (C) music gave me hope and a sense of satisfaction.
ex.t: 此外,(C)音乐给了我希望和满足感。

ex.s: Sam completed the final year of his career with great satisfaction.
ex.t: 萨姆以极大的满意完成了职业生涯的最后一年.

ex.s: SATISFACTION GUARANTEED (Adapted) Larry Belmont worked for a company that made robots.
ex.t: SATISFACTION GUARANTED (Adapted) Larry Belmont在一家制造机器人的公司工作.

ex.s: I actually wanted to drop the class at one point, but stopped short because I didn't want to give him the satisfaction of my chickening out.
ex.t: 我有一次其实想退掉这门课，但没退成，因为我不想让他因我的退缩而得逞。

ex.s: It will bring you more satisfaction and help contribute to your future.
ex.t: 它会给你带来更多的满足 并有助于为你的未来做出贡献。

defs.def: the act of fulfilling a need or desire （需要或欲望的）满足，达到
an acceptable way of dealing with a complaint, a debt, an injury, etc. （抗议、投诉等的）妥善处理；（债务的）清偿；（伤害的）赔偿
